## [OUR HERITAGE IS OUR PRIDE](https://jungfraualetsch.ch/en/\#intro)

[Learn more](https://jungfraualetsch.ch/en/#intro)

# Welcome

Imposing mountain ranges, rustic valleys and the largest contiguous glacial area in the Alps: it was clear to UNESCO that this site deserved its place in the world heritage. Set out now to discover the Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch and find out everything you need to know about the first Alpine World Heritage Site on this site.

![](https://jungfraualetsch.ch/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/intro_pat_A34A9544.jpg)
